atoms.exact_source_text: Suitable seasonal and Colony conditions permit a Nesting commitment.
atoms.normalized_claim: Season opens phase: suitable seasonal and Colony conditions permit a Nesting commitment.

atoms.exact_source_text: The option becomes available; nothing happens automatically.
atoms.normalized_claim: When season opens, the Nesting option becomes available but nothing happens automatically.

atoms.exact_source_text: An eligible Hearth expresses readiness.
atoms.normalized_claim: Hearth willingness phase: an eligible Hearth expresses readiness.

atoms.exact_source_text: The game names the household; the player does not pair anonymous breeders.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game names the household in Hearth willingness; the player does not pair anonymous breeders.

atoms.exact_source_text: Residence, Stores, Caretaking, Healing, Teaching, Leadership, and seasonal forecast are previewed.
atoms.normalized_claim: Capacity review phase previews Residence, Stores, Caretaking, Healing, Teaching, Leadership, and seasonal forecast.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player sees what will become Thin and which adults lose flexibility.
atoms.normalized_claim: In capacity review, the player sees what will become Thin and which adults lose flexibility.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player begins a long civic commitment.
atoms.normalized_claim: Authorization phase: the player begins a long civic commitment.

atoms.exact_source_text: This is closer to authorizing a consequential Project than producing a unit.
atoms.normalized_claim: Authorizing Nesting is closer to authorizing a consequential Project than producing a unit.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Hearth is protected from ordinary Away use and may lose flexible Home availability.
atoms.normalized_claim: During the critical period, the Hearth is protected from ordinary Away use and may lose flexible Home availability.

atoms.exact_source_text: The exact temporary cost is visible before commitment.
atoms.normalized_claim: The exact temporary cost of the critical period is visible before commitment.

atoms.exact_source_text: A very small number of young enter the Roster and receive Given Names.
atoms.normalized_claim: Naming phase: a very small number of young enter the Roster and receive Given Names.

atoms.exact_source_text: Population and Load rise immediately; Capacity does not.
atoms.normalized_claim: At naming, Population and Load rise immediately but Capacity does not.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Rabbit**            | One named young Citizen                | Preserves rarity, individual attachment, and campaign pacing.                             |
atoms.normalized_claim: For Rabbit, the default successful Nesting outcome is one named young Citizen, designed to preserve rarity, individual attachment, and campaign pacing.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Squirrel**          | One named young Citizen                | Preserves rarity, individual attachment, and campaign pacing.                             |
atoms.normalized_claim: For Squirrel, the default successful Nesting outcome is one named young Citizen, designed to preserve rarity, individual attachment, and campaign pacing.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Wood Mouse**        | Two named littermates                  | Expresses denser Mouse population without simulating large litters or creating anonymity. |
atoms.normalized_claim: For Wood Mouse, the default successful Nesting outcome is two named littermates, expressing denser Mouse population without simulating large litters or creating anonymity.

atoms.exact_source_text: This is a sourcebook and balance rule, not a literal claim about animal biology.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Nesting outcome table is a sourcebook and balance rule, not a literal claim about animal biology.

atoms.exact_source_text: Exact biology is stylized consistently to protect the low-population design ceiling.
atoms.normalized_claim: Exact biology is stylized consistently to protect the low-population design ceiling.

atoms.exact_source_text: Normally only one successful Nesting commitment resolves per Colony-wide seasonal window.
atoms.normalized_claim: Normally only one successful Nesting commitment resolves per Colony-wide seasonal window.

atoms.exact_source_text: A young Citizen is fully named and fully counted from arrival.
atoms.normalized_claim: A young Citizen is fully named and fully counted from arrival.

atoms.exact_source_text: They receive a Citizen Record, relationships, a Residence association, and Campaign Memory.
atoms.normalized_claim: A young Citizen receives a Citizen Record, relationships, a Residence association, and Campaign Memory.

atoms.exact_source_text: They may be present in DWELL, Home MEET, Story Circle life, and eligible forms of Home-only EMBODY.
atoms.normalized_claim: A young Citizen may be present in DWELL, Home MEET, Story Circle life, and eligible forms of Home-only EMBODY.

atoms.exact_source_text: They are not an inventory item waiting to become a real character.
atoms.normalized_claim: A young Citizen is not an inventory item waiting to become a real character.

atoms.exact_source_text: Young Citizens provide no ordinary Role Capacity and may not Launch.
atoms.normalized_claim: Young Citizens provide no ordinary Role Capacity and may not Launch.

atoms.exact_source_text: They add Dependence Load first: Caretaking, Teaching, Sustenance, Residence, protection, and occasionally Healing or Leadership.
atoms.normalized_claim: Young Citizens add Dependence Load first, including Caretaking, Teaching, Sustenance, Residence, protection, and occasionally Healing or Leadership.

atoms.exact_source_text: Nursery growth therefore tests whether the Colony has actual margin rather than creating the labor needed to cover its own cost.
atoms.normalized_claim: Nursery growth tests whether the Colony has actual margin rather than creating the labor needed to cover its own cost.
